schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
schemes.description: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana is a government-funded health assurance scheme for eligible beneficiaries.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible families identified under PM-JAY and applicable state criteria; Indian citizens aged 70 years or above may qualify under the senior citizen expansion. Verify through the official beneficiary portal.
schemes.benefits: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization at empanelled hospitals, with annual coverage of up to Rs. 5 lakh per eligible family.

schemes.name: Central Government Health Scheme
schemes.description: Central Government Health Scheme provides healthcare services to eligible central government beneficiaries.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible serving or retired central government employees, dependants and other notified beneficiary categories.
schemes.benefits: Outpatient care, medicines, investigations, specialist consultations and treatment through CGHS facilities and empanelled healthcare providers, subject to scheme rules.

schemes.name: National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme
schemes.description: National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme is a public health programme for tuberculosis prevention, diagnosis and treatment.
schemes.eligibility: People requiring TB evaluation or treatment in India, subject to applicable programme services and guidelines.
schemes.benefits: Free TB diagnostic and treatment services through the public health system, along with applicable patient support.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission
schemes.description: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission develops India's digital health ecosystem and enables interoperable health information systems.
schemes.eligibility: Individuals can participate in available ABDM digital health services, subject to registration and applicable requirements.
schemes.benefits: Digital health identity through ABHA and consent-based access to and sharing of digital health records through participating systems. It does not itself provide hospital insurance coverage.

schemes.name: Employees' State Insurance Scheme
schemes.description: A statutory social security scheme administered by the Employees' State Insurance Corporation.
schemes.benefits: Medical care and other applicable social security benefits for insured persons and eligible dependants.
schemes.eligibility: Employees covered under the ESI Act and eligible family members, subject to applicable contribution and coverage rules.

schemes.name: Rajasthan Government Health Scheme
schemes.description: A healthcare scheme for specified categories of Rajasthan government beneficiaries.
schemes.benefits: Cashless healthcare services for eligible beneficiaries, subject to scheme rules and empanelment.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible Rajasthan government employees, pensioners and other notified beneficiary categories, subject to current RGHS rules.
